name: Baby Toothbrush Baby Tongue Cleaner for 0-18 Months 3pcs Set Multicolor Toddler Baby Care 3pcs set with Box
description: The LunaSly Baby 3-Peice Oral Care Set is the perfect toothbrush starting set for your baby. Each piece is designed for a different task and designed perfectly to accomplish them. The tongue cleaner has ridges and groves on both sides to clean your baby’s tongue and ensure they have a healthy mouth. The U-shape is perfect for massaging your baby’s gums as their teeth start to grow in. With its shape, it is able to wrap around a baby's gums at once while also being soft and soothing. This small toothbrush is the perfect way for babies to learn to start cleaning their teeth. The bristles are sized so that they won’t be too rough but are also able to soothe and clean effectively. The brushes are just over 3 inches in length making them a perfect fit in your baby’s hand while they learn to clean their teeth and soothe their gums. Our oral care set is 100% Food-grade silicone, BPA-free, Lead-free, and Phthalate free making it completely safe for your baby. Recommended before first use, disinfect in boiling water for 5 minutes. Store in a dry and cool place do not leave in direct sunlight, hot surface, or corrosive materials as it may damage the product over time.
